Two scalar measures were used to assess blood oxygenation level dependent activation in each region: 1) the magnitude of activation was defined as the percent change in the mean regional signal intensities measured between the neutral and cocaine-cue segments of the acquisition, and 2) the spatial extent of activation was defined as the fraction of pixels in each region that exceeded an arbitrary activation threshold of r=0.30 according to the correlation coefficient detection technique of Bandettini et al.
